about: Curated per-variable notes for docs/reference/configuration.md. Verified against shared/config.py, api/app/config.py, api/app/core/, docker-compose*.yml and install.sh on release/3.0.0. Variables themselves come from data/repo.json (.env.example).

DEBUG.note: Relaxes the startup checks, serves `/docs`, `/redoc` and `/openapi.json`, and skips the password strength rules. Session cookies are `Secure` only when it is off.

LOG_LEVEL.note: Log level of the api, the workers, channels and ct-stream.

SQL_ECHO.note: Logs every SQL statement and its parameters.

POSTGRES_DB.note: Database name. `rengine restore` asks for it to confirm a restore.

POSTGRES_MAX_CONNECTIONS.note: `max_connections` of the db service. The api logs a warning at startup when the pools can open more connections than this allows.

POSTGRES_MAX_WAL_SIZE.note: Disk the write-ahead log may hold between checkpoints.

DB_POOL_SIZE.note: Connections in the pool of each api process.

DB_MAX_OVERFLOW.note: Connections above the pool size for each api process.

DB_POOL_TIMEOUT.note: Seconds to wait for a pooled connection.

DB_POOL_RECYCLE.note: Seconds before a pooled connection is replaced. Applies to the api and the workers.

DB_IDLE_TX_TIMEOUT.note: Seconds idle inside a transaction before Postgres ends the connection. `0` disables.

WORKER_DB_POOL_SIZE.note: Connections in the pool of each worker child process.

WORKER_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW.note: Connections above the pool size for each worker child process.

WORKER_DB_POOL_TIMEOUT.note: Seconds a worker waits for a pooled connection.

REDIS_HOST.note: Redis instance for the task broker and live state.

REDIS_DB.note: Database of the broker. The task result backend uses the next database number.

REDIS_PASSWORD.note: Password of both Redis instances. No whitespace, quotes or backslashes.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY.note: `maxmemory` of the broker Redis, which does not evict.

REDIS_CACHE_HOST.note: Redis instance for cached aggregates, which evicts the least recently used keys.

CELERY_SCAN_CONCURRENCY.note: Stage slots in each worker-scans container. Each slot runs one tool.

CELERY_CONTROL_CONCURRENCY.note: Slots of worker-control: launch, step hand-over, resume and finalize.

CELERY_DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY.note: Slots of worker-default: background jobs and toolbox runs.

TASK_SOFT_TIME_LIMIT.note: Seconds before a task is asked to stop, 6 hours.

TASK_HARD_TIME_LIMIT.note: Seconds before a task is ended, 8 hours. The broker visibility timeout and the result expiry are this value plus one hour.

SECRET_KEY.note: Instance key. Encrypts stored credentials, tokens and two-factor secrets. Required. Outside `DEBUG` it must be at least 32 characters.

JWT_SECRET_KEY.note: Signs sessions. Read by the api service alone. Required unless `DEBUG=true`, where an empty value is derived from `SECRET_KEY`. Must differ from `SECRET_KEY`.

ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES.note: Lifetime of an access token and its cookie, in minutes.

REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS.note: Lifetime of a refresh token and its cookie, in days.

CORS_ORIGINS.note: JSON list of allowed origins. `*` is refused. The first entry is also the base URL of links to the interface.

API_RELOAD.note: `true` runs one api process with reload. `false` runs `API_WORKERS` processes.

GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.note: Requests a minute per signed-in user, or per client address without a valid session. `0` or less disables. `/api/v1/events` and `/api/v1/media` are exempt. Over the limit the api answers 429 with `Retry-After`.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.note: Comma-separated CIDRs whose `X-Forwarded-For` header is read.

ADMIN_EMAIL.note: Email of the first administrator, created when no user exists.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.note: Password of the first administrator. Outside `DEBUG`, the api refuses to start with the example value or fewer than 10 characters when no user exists.

BIND_ADDR.note: Development compose: address of the published db, redis and flower ports.

APP_BIND_ADDR.note: Development compose: address of the published api and frontend ports. `0.0.0.0` publishes on every interface.

FLOWER_USER.note: Flower user, under the `debug` compose profile.

EGRESS_PROXY_URL.note: Proxy for outbound calls that are not scan traffic: intel feeds, RDAP and RIPEstat.

EGRESS_TIMEOUT.note: Timeout of those calls, in seconds.

extra.name: RENGINE_TAG
extra.note: Image tag of the installed release. `rengine version` prints it.

extra.name: RENGINE_SRC
extra.note: The checkout path of a source install, empty otherwise.

extra.name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
extra.note: The origin of the interface. `rengine status` checks the API at this origin.

extra.name: RENGINE_HOST
extra.note: The domain in domain mode, empty otherwise.

extra.name: WORKER_SCANS_REPLICAS
extra.note: Number of worker-scans containers, 1 by default.

extra.name: EGRESS_USER_AGENT
extra.note: User agent of outbound calls that are not scan traffic.

extra.name: RENGINE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE
extra.note: Supplies the passphrase of a backup or a restore without a prompt.
